turn.user_message: Is it worth what it costs?
turn.context: Solutions place, turn 5 (playbook §7: cost against what is at stake, a threshold already met).

text: Yes. Put one Discharge Manager in place now, and start the two-week trial.
At 40 to 45 discharges a day, this is not a maybe-someday. You are already there.
The team costs a small part of what the wait costs, even if the trial wins back very little.
chat.note: The team costs about a hundredth of what the wait does.
prompts: Why the Manager before the trial?
Can we start with one person?
chat.pointer: The two figures read against each other. Ask about either one.
